demo.inspiration_text: I want a compact organiser for my study desk with room for my pens, my phone and an A5 notebook. The shelf above only leaves 18 cm of depth, and I rent this flat so no drilling. Something warm like bamboo would be lovely. Around 3,000 rupees, and I can't go above 3,500.
demo.desk_photo_prompt: Realistic phone photo of a small study desk in an Indian apartment, a wooden shelf mounted low above the desk, scattered pens, a smartphone and an A5 notebook on the desk, laptop to one side, natural window light, slightly cluttered, no people, no text, no logos.
